name: Creativanta

screens.title: Web — Analytics Detail Report

screens.title: Web — Gamification Dashboard

screens.title: Web — Analytics Overview
screens.purpose: The Analytics Overview is the reporting hub — aggregated metrics across all platforms with drill-down capability. Shows content performance, audience growth, engagement trends, and top-performing content with AI-powered insights.

screens.title: Web — Performance Coach
screens.purpose: AI-powered content coaching — weekly report card with overall grade, post-by-post performance insights, strengths/weaknesses analysis, and strategic recommendations for content improvement. This is the "learn" feedback loop in the Trend-to-Profit pipeline.

screens.title: Web — Post Analytics Detail
screens.purpose: Per-post deep analytics — real-time metrics, reach curve over 72h, audience demographics, AI-powered performance analysis, peer comparison, and revenue attribution.

screens.title: Web — Forgot Password
screens.purpose: Allows users who have forgotten their password to initiate a password reset flow. This is a critical auth recovery path that must be secure yet user-friendly.

screens.title: Web — Authentication: Login
screens.purpose: The Login page is the primary authentication entry point for Creativanta web application. It supports email/password login, social OAuth (Google, Apple), and magic link authentication. This is the first impression screen — it must look polished, trustworthy, and load fast.

screens.title: Web — Authentication: Register
screens.purpose: The Registration page is the entry point for new users into the Creativanta ecosystem. It supports email/password registration and social OAuth (Google, Apple). screens.title: Web — Capability Matrix

screens.title: Web — Affiliate Links Overview
screens.purpose: The Affiliate Links Overview screen manages affiliate link generation, tracking, and performance monitoring. It shows the click → order → revenue funnel per link with source class badges and health monitoring.

screens.title: Web — Affiliate Manager
screens.purpose: The Affiliate Manager is the command center for all affiliate/referral links. It tracks click-through rates, conversion data, commission earnings, and source content attribution across platforms (TikTok Shop, Shopee, custom links). screens.title: Web — Campaign Detail

screens.title: Web — Campaign Manager
screens.purpose: Marketing campaign manager — the umbrella entity that groups products, offers, content, and affiliate links with unified performance tracking, ROI attribution, and budget control. Campaigns connect the content pipeline to commerce outcomes.

screens.title: Web — Coupon Manager
screens.purpose: Create and manage discount coupons across platforms with usage tracking, revenue impact analysis, and platform distribution. Coupons are the promotional instrument layer — used inside campaigns, shared via affiliate links, or distributed directly to customers.

screens.title: Web — Inventory & Stock Management
screens.purpose: Centralized inventory management view for tracking stock levels across multiple locations and platforms. Essential for Seller Mode and Live Operator Mode users who need real-time stock visibility.

screens.title: Web — Membership Plans
screens.purpose: Membership Plans is the creator's subscription management dashboard — create and manage paid membership tiers for audiences. screens.title: Web — Offer Detail / Create
screens.purpose: The Offer Detail screen is the primary form for creating and editing promotional offers. It supports 4 offer types (percentage, fixed amount, bundle, free gift), product association, time/quantity constraints, and multi-channel distribution (coupon codes, affiliate links, campaigns). This

screens.title: Web — Offer & Coupon Manager
screens.purpose: The Offer & Coupon Manager is the central hub for all promotional offers. Shows all offers across statuses (active, scheduled, paused, expired) with real-time redemption tracking, revenue impact, and platform distribution. This is the primary entry point for the offer lifecycle — from crea

screens.title: Web — Order Detail
screens.purpose: Full order detail page showing order items, buyer information, price breakdown with platform fees, delivery timeline, content attribution, and profit calculation. This is where commerce data connects to the Profit OS proof chain — every fee and deduction is itemized and source-attributed.

screens.title: Web — Order Management
screens.purpose: Cross-platform order list that aggregates all orders synced from TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada, and direct store channels into one unified view. screens.title: Web — Product Detail

screens.title: Web — Product List
screens.purpose: The Product List displays all products in the workspace — synced from e-commerce platforms (TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada) and manually created. screens.title: Web — Refund Management
screens.purpose: Track and process refund requests across all connected platforms. Pipeline view with evidence review, customer purchase history, and accept/reject workflow. Refunds are critical for accurate Profit OS calculations — every refund adjusts the operating ledger.

screens.title: Web — Sample Requests
screens.purpose: Sample Requests manages the lifecycle of product sample distribution to influencers/reviewers from the commerce perspective. screens.title: Web — Store Pages & Editor
screens.purpose: Store Pages is the no-code micro-storefront builder — creators build product landing pages with a visual drag-and-drop editor, then publish to creativanta.link/shop/{slug}. Supports hero banners, product grids, testimonials, about sections, FAQ, and custom HTML. Includes live preview, them

screens.title: Web — Asset Brief Editor
screens.purpose: The Asset Brief is the visual production plan that bridges Script → AI Studio. It defines shot-by-shot visual notes, reference images, color palettes, and product placements. This document guides both AI generation and human production.

screens.title: Web — Continuity Packs
screens.purpose: Continuity Packs is the "character bible" for AI-generated content — a management hub for reusable character profiles, brand kits, and voice presets that ensure consistency across all AI-generated videos, scripts, and TTS output. When a creator sets up "Chef Hùng" as a character with speci

screens.title: Web — Derivative Manager
screens.purpose: Manage content derivatives — repurposed/remixed versions of original content for different platforms. Tree structure groups derivatives under their source content, showing platform-specific adaptations (aspect ratios, durations, formats) and their publish status.

screens.title: Web — Idea Board
screens.purpose: The Idea Board is the content pipeline's front door — a Kanban-style board for capturing, scoring, prioritizing, and advancing content ideas through stages: Inbox → Evaluating → Approved → In Script → Done. Ideas can be created manually (one-click capture from anywhere), generated by AI (b

screens.title: Web — Idea Detail
screens.purpose: Full detail view of a single idea. Shows the idea's origin (manual/AI/trend/opportunity), AI score breakdown, attached references, linked scripts, and conversion actions. Also serves as the editing interface for idea enrichment.

screens.title: Web — AI Idea Generator
screens.purpose: The AI Idea Generator creates content ideas from natural language prompts, trends, audience data, and product catalog. Users describe what they want ("content ideas about skincare for TikTok"), and AI generates 10+ scored suggestions with titles, hooks, format suggestions, and estimated pe

screens.title: Web — Script Editor
screens.purpose: The Script Editor is the primary content writing workspace — a structured, AI-augmented editor with section-based composition (Hook, Body, CTA), real-time brand voice enforcement, platform-specific guidelines, version history, and a review/approval workflow. Scripts link to ideas upstream

screens.title: Web — Script List
screens.purpose: Script List displays all scripts in the workspace with status filtering, search, and quick stats. The bridge between the Idea Board (upstream) and the AI Studio/Publish pipeline (downstream). Designed for rapid triage — see what needs writing, reviewing, or is ready for production.

screens.title: Web — Script Approval Review
screens.purpose: Script review mode — read-only script view with inline commenting, approval/rejection workflow, and change request tracking. Reviewers can add feedback per section and make a final decision.

screens.title: Web — Brand Deal Manager
screens.purpose: Brand deal tracking with full pipeline — manage partnerships from negotiation through delivery to payment. Includes deliverable checklists, payment tracking, and deal performance analytics.

screens.title: Deal Contract Templates and Evidence
screens.purpose: Read Creator Pro §12 and API behavior §8. Brand deal and evidence remain canonical objects.

screens.title: Public Creator Directory
screens.purpose: Read Creator Pro §12, then API behavior §8 and schema §27.2. The directory exposes only explicitly consented published snapshots.

screens.title: Web — Sponsor Inquiries
screens.purpose: Manage incoming sponsor and brand collaboration inquiries with a status pipeline: New → Negotiating → Accepted → Declined. Inquiries come from brands contacting the creator through various channels — the system aggregates them into a single inbox-like view.

screens.title: Web — Link-in-Bio Builder
screens.purpose: Build a personal landing page at creativanta.link/{username} with drag-reorder links, theme selection, analytics, and optional custom domain.

screens.title: Web — Media Kit Editor
screens.purpose: Build and share a professional media kit — auto-synced statistics from connected platforms, audience demographics, curated portfolio, customizable rate card, and shareable public link with PDF download.

screens.title: Web — Partnership Manager
screens.purpose: The Partnership Manager tracks active brand collaborations — deliverables, deadlines, payments, proof of performance. This is the operational center for Brand Collaboration operator mode users managing sponsor relationships.

screens.title: Web — Creator Pro Dashboard
screens.purpose: Creator-specific command center — engagement KPIs with cross-platform aggregation, active brand partnerships with deliverable tracking, real-time sponsor inquiry alerts, and quick access to Media Kit and Rate Card tools.

screens.title: Web — Rate Card Builder
screens.purpose: Build a professional pricing table for brand collaborations — editable service pricing with AI-suggested rates based on engagement metrics, niche, and market benchmarks. The rate card feeds into the Media Kit (W089) and Sponsor Inquiries (W090) for automated budget comparison.

screens.title: Web — Revenue Per Content
screens.purpose: Revenue attribution per content piece — track ROI of every video/post by connecting content creation costs to revenue generated through that content. Shows RPM (Revenue Per Mille) trends, production cost analysis, and AI-generated optimization insights.

screens.title: Web — Tax Report Export
screens.purpose: Export income reports for tax filing — monthly/quarterly/yearly with income & expense breakdown by source, net calculation, multi-format export, and trust-level annotations.

screens.title: Web — Bulk Triage
screens.purpose: Bulk Triage is a rapid processing mode for clearing inbox backlog. Threads are presented one-at-a-time (Tinder-like card swipe UX), with pre-generated AI replies. Users can quickly approve replies, modify, assign, or skip.

screens.title: Web — Contact Detail
screens.purpose: Full profile view of a single contact — showing all interactions, purchase history, platform presence, and AI-generated engagement recommendations.

screens.title: Web — Contact List
screens.purpose: Contact List is a lightweight CRM showing all people who have interacted with the creator — commenters, DM senders, buyers, collaborators. AI auto-enriches profiles with purchase history, engagement frequency, and customer value scoring.

screens.title: Web — Follow-up Tasks
screens.purpose: Follow-up Tasks tracks pending actions created from inbox threads — e.g., "Send product sample to @customer", "Create special offer for VIP buyer", "Follow up on collaboration inquiry". Each task links to its source thread.

screens.title: Web — Thread Detail
screens.purpose: Full-page thread view — an alternative to the split-pane inbox for deep-link access and focused conversations. Shows the complete message history with AI intent classification and suggested replies.

screens.title: Web — Unified Inbox
screens.purpose: The Unified Inbox aggregates comments, DMs, and mentions from all connected platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Shopee, Facebook) into a single split-pane interface. AI-powered intent detection classifies each message (purchase inquiry, praise, criticism, complaint, question, spam), aut

screens.title: Web — Finance: Cost Detail
screens.purpose: Cost breakdown by category — platform fees, AI credits, advertising, shipping, COGS, and custom costs. Period trends with optimization hints from the AI Copilot. This is the cost truth layer: every cost is categorized, source-attributed, and deducted from revenue in Profit OS.

screens.title: Web — Finance: Profit Dashboard
screens.purpose: Main finance dashboard — net profit overview with trust annotations, revenue vs cost trend, margin health tracking, and quick links to detailed breakdowns. The command center for financial health.

screens.title: Web — Profit Dashboard
screens.purpose: The Profit Dashboard is the financial cockpit of Creativanta — showing real net profit (revenue minus all costs), revenue breakdown by platform/product, cost tracking by category, reconciliation status per platform, and proof audit trail. Every financial number is traceable to its source v

screens.title: Web — Proof Browser
screens.purpose: Browse and verify proof bundles — evidence objects that support financial claims. This is the trust accountability layer of Profit OS: every financial number (revenue, cost, profit) must trace back to proof items. Proof bundles group evidence by period and claim type, showing coverage gaps

screens.title: Web — Reconciliation Center
screens.purpose: Reconcile financial data across platforms — match orders ↔ settlements ↔ payouts automatically, then surface anomalies and conflicts for human review. This is the "trust audit" layer: every VND of revenue must trace to a settlement, and every settlement must trace to real orders.

screens.title: Web — Financial Reports
screens.purpose: Generate P&L statements, cash flow summaries, and custom financial reports with trust annotations (source class badges) and multi-format export (CSV, PDF, Google Sheets).

screens.title: Web — Finance: Revenue Detail
screens.purpose: Revenue breakdown by source, platform, product, and content — with period comparison, trend analysis, source class transparency, and export capability. This is the "revenue truth" screen where every VND is attributed and source-classified per PRD §33 operating ledger requirements.

screens.title: Web — Settlement Tracker
screens.purpose: Track platform payouts/settlements — match settlements to orders, verify bank deposit references, and resolve amount mismatches. Settlements are the "proof of payment" from platforms: they confirm how much money was actually transferred to the creator's bank account.

screens.title: Web — Copilot Dialog
screens.purpose: The AI Copilot is a conversational AI assistant that slides in from the right side of any page. It can answer questions about the workspace data, suggest actions, generate content, and help with decision-making. Context-aware: it knows what page the user is on and can reference visible dat

screens.title: Web — Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: The Home Dashboard is the primary landing page after workspace selection. It serves as the decision cockpit — an intelligence-first overview showing what's happening now, what needs attention, and what to do next. It is NOT a generic dashboard with static metrics; it is dynamically persona

screens.title: Web — Global Search
screens.purpose: Global Search provides instant cross-entity search across ideas, scripts, trends, products, orders, contacts, and asset files. Powered by Meilisearch for typo-tolerant, sub-50ms results. Accessible via Cmd+K shortcut anywhere in the app.

screens.title: Web — Morning Brief
screens.purpose: The Morning Brief is an AI-generated daily operational summary — a "newsletter for your business" that includes overnight financial highlights, trending signals worth acting on, top-performing content, suggested priority actions, and operational warnings. Designed for a 2-3 minute scan to

screens.title: Web — Notification Center
screens.purpose: The Notification Center aggregates all system notifications — from new orders, publishing events, AI results, team mentions, and platform alerts. It has two modes: a dropdown (bell icon in topbar) for quick glance, and a full page for browsing history.

screens.title: Web — Onboarding Setup
screens.purpose: Multi-step onboarding wizard activated after first workspace creation. Guides new users through: profile setup → connect platforms → set preferences → choose operator mode → complete. Each step is skippable but encouraged.

screens.title: Web — Quick Action Menu
screens.purpose: The Quick Action Menu is a floating action button (FAB) permanently anchored to the bottom-right of every app page. When activated, it expands into a radial or stacked menu offering one-tap access to the most frequent creation actions across all modules. This eliminates the need to navigat

screens.title: Web — Settings Page
screens.purpose: Settings hub — the navigation page for all workspace and account configuration. Shows a sidebar with settings categories and a main content area for the selected category.

screens.title: Web — Workspace Selector
screens.purpose: The Workspace Selector is the first screen after Clerk authentication. Users with multiple workspaces choose which to enter. Users with a single workspace are auto-redirected to Home Dashboard (/). Also accessible anytime via the workspace dropdown in the sidebar.

screens.title: Web — Benchmark View
screens.purpose: The Benchmark View provides side-by-side comparison of the user's metrics vs tracked competitors. Shows where the user leads or lags across key metrics (followers, engagement, posting frequency, content performance, growth rate).

screens.title: Web — Competitor Registry
screens.purpose: The Competitor Registry lets creators track competitor accounts across platforms. AI scores each competitor for relevance, monitors posting patterns, and feeds into the Benchmark View for comparative analysis.

screens.title: Web — Opportunity Board
screens.purpose: The Opportunity Board surfaces AI-scored opportunities — content gaps, trending topics the user hasn't covered, under-served niches, and content types with high potential. Opportunities are generated daily by the AI Copilot from trend data, competitor analysis, and audience signals.

screens.title: Web — Opportunity Convert
screens.purpose: Guided wizard to convert an opportunity into actionable content. Users choose between quick idea creation, direct script writing, or multi-piece planning. Pre-filled with AI suggestions from the opportunity analysis.

screens.title: Web — Opportunity Detail
screens.purpose: Full detail view of a single AI-generated opportunity. Shows the complete analysis, supporting evidence, action history, and conversion path. This is the "intelligence brief" that justifies why this opportunity is worth pursuing.

screens.title: Web — Trend Detail
screens.purpose: Deep-dive into a single trend — showing its trajectory over time, related content, top-performing examples, audience overlap scores, and one-click conversion to ideas/scripts. This is the "intelligence brief" for a trend.

screens.title: Web — Trend Radar
screens.purpose: The Trend Radar is the intelligence engine's primary discovery interface — a real-time "content weather map" showing what's trending across connected platforms (TikTok, YouTube, Shopee, Google Trends, Instagram). The screen combines AI-powered scoring, multi-axis filtering, sparkline visua

screens.title: Web — Watchlist Manager
screens.purpose: Watchlists allow creators to organize and track trends they're interested in. Users can create multiple named watchlists (e.g., "Beauty Trends", "Food Content Ideas") and receive notifications when watched trends change significantly.

screens.title: Web — Live Session Planner
screens.purpose: Plan and manage live selling sessions — view upcoming, active, and past sessions with quick access to setup, war room, and post-live analytics. The planner follows the PRD live commerce flow: Plan → Setup → War Room → Post-Live Summary.

screens.title: Web — Live Session Setup
screens.purpose: Prepare everything for a live session — product lineup with drag-reorder, cue cards with timing, special offers configuration, and pre-live equipment checklist. This is the "Prepare" step: Plan → Setup → War Room → Post-Live.

screens.title: Web — Post-Live Summary
screens.purpose: Post-session analytics with AI-generated improvement suggestions — session KPIs, viewer engagement timeline, per-product performance, chat pattern analysis, and highlight clips. This is the "learn & improve" step of the Live Commerce flow: Plan → Setup → War Room → Post-Live Summary.

screens.title: Web — Live War Room
screens.purpose: Full-screen live selling command center — product queue, AI chat triage, real-time stats, and quick actions (flash sale, highlight, coupon). No sidebar — maximum screen real estate.

screens.title: Monetization OS (Web) — M14
screens.purpose: Central monetization management surface for offers, coupons, campaigns, and conversion tracking. Aggregates offers from multiple channels (Creator Store, Social, Affiliate, Link-in-Bio) into a unified view with ROI metrics.

screens.title: Web — Schedule Calendar
screens.purpose: The Schedule Calendar is the visual content planning hub — a week/month calendar view displaying all scheduled, published, and draft content across platforms. Creators can visually plan content cadence, identify posting gaps, drag-to-reschedule posts, and see AI-recommended optimal time sl

screens.title: Web — Content Calendar (Full View)
screens.purpose: Full calendar view with month/week/day modes showing all scheduled, published, and draft content. Color-coded by platform with drag-to-reschedule and AI optimal time overlay.

screens.title: Web — Channel Posts
screens.purpose: Channel Posts is the retrospective content library — a unified view of all published content across every connected platform (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X/Twitter, Facebook). It shows per-post performance metrics, cross-platform comparison insights, and provides quick actions for derivati

screens.title: Web — Publish Composer
screens.purpose: The Publish Composer is the multi-platform content creation and scheduling hub — a single split-screen form where creators compose a post (attach media, write caption, manage hashtags) and publish or schedule to multiple social platforms simultaneously. Each platform gets a live preview mo

screens.title: Web — Publish Diagnostics
screens.purpose: Deep technical diagnostics for a publish item — API call logs, platform capability state at publish time, error traces, retry history, and actionable recommendations. This is the debugging surface when a publish fails or partially succeeds.

screens.title: Web — Publish Item Detail
screens.purpose: The Publish Item Detail screen provides a comprehensive view of a single piece of published (or in-flight) content — its media preview, per-platform publish status with real-time logs, early performance metrics, and lineage back to the original idea/script/trend. This is the "mission contr

screens.title: Web — Packaging QA
screens.purpose: Packaging QA is the automated pre-publish quality gate: before content goes live, it runs a comprehensive checklist of technical, content, brand, and platform-specific checks against the asset. The creator gets a clear pass/warning/fail scorecard with actionable fix suggestions, inline edi

screens.title: Web — Publish Queue
screens.purpose: The Publish Queue is the primary execution dashboard for content publishing. It shows all publish jobs across four states: Scheduled, Publishing, Published, and Failed. Users can preview, edit, publish immediately, pause, retry failed posts, and view diagnostics.

screens.title: Web — Seeding Creator Assignment
screens.purpose: Assign products to external creators (KOLs) and track their deliverables through the seeding pipeline: Assigned → Shipped → Received → Creating → Published. This is the operational CRM for managing product seeding relationships.

screens.title: Web — Seeding Campaign Dashboard
screens.purpose: Campaign-level view of seeding effectiveness — products seeded to creators, content output tracking, reach measurement, and ROI calculation. Seeding campaigns are the systematic outreach programs where brands send free products to KOLs/creators in exchange for content creation.

screens.title: Web — Seeding Request Manager
screens.purpose: Manage sample product requests to creators/influencers for review content. Pipeline view tracks the entire lifecycle: requested → approved → shipped → received → review published.

screens.title: Web — Settings: AI Preferences
screens.purpose: AI behavior preferences — default generation quality, credit usage limits, voice/style defaults, and AI model preferences per feature. Controls how all AI features behave workspace-wide.

screens.title: Web — Settings: API Keys
screens.purpose: Manage API access tokens (Pro+ only) — create keys with scoped permissions, rotate keys safely, revoke compromised keys, and monitor usage with rate limit tracking.

screens.title: Web — Settings: Billing & Plan
screens.purpose: The Billing & Plan screen is the financial command center for workspace subscription management. Creators can view their current plan and usage, upgrade/downgrade between tiers, purchase additional AI credits, manage payment methods (via Stripe), view billing history with downloadable invo

screens.title: Web — Settings: Brand Voice & Identity
screens.purpose: Configure brand identity: voice profile, visual guidelines, target audience, and content themes. Used by AI Copilot, Script Editor, and all Studio modes to maintain brand consistency.

screens.title: Web — Connected Account Detail
screens.purpose: Deep settings for a connected platform account — sync frequency per data type, data retention policies, OAuth token management, capability status, and sync history with error logs.

screens.title: Web — Settings: Connected Accounts
screens.purpose: Manage all platform connections — social media (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook) and commerce platforms (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop). Shows per-platform capability status, rate limit usage, sync history, and connection health. This is the "nerve center" for all external integrations.

screens.title: Web — Credit Purchase
screens.purpose: Buy additional AI credits — credit packs with tiered pricing (bulk discounts), auto-refill configuration, usage projection highlighting urgency, and payment method management.

screens.title: Web — AI Credit Usage
screens.purpose: Track AI credit consumption — balance with depletion forecast, daily usage chart by AI mode, and detailed usage history with filtering.

screens.title: Web — Settings: Credit Purchase
screens.purpose: Buy additional AI credits — credit packs with volume discounts, auto-refill configuration, usage analytics, and depletion projections.

screens.title: Web — Data Export & Account Deletion
screens.purpose: GDPR/PDPA compliant screen for users to request data export (right to portability) and account/workspace deletion (right to erasure). This is a legal launch requirement.

screens.title: Web — Diagnostics Center
screens.purpose: System health overview — all active issues, warnings, degraded services with 4-step repair wizard. Monitors platform connectors, AI providers, database, cache, and search services.

screens.title: Web — Settings: Workspace Members
screens.purpose: Manage workspace members — invite by email, assign canonical roles (Owner, Admin, Manager, Editor, Contributor, Viewer, External), transfer ownership, remove members, and track pending invitations. Roles follow the B5 §2 canonical 7-role workspace RBAC model.

screens.title: Web — Settings: Notifications
screens.purpose: Notification preferences — granular control over push, email, and in-app notifications per event type. Includes quiet hours, email digest frequency, and team mention controls.

screens.title: Web — Settings: Referral Center
screens.purpose: Referral program dashboard — personal referral link with multi-channel sharing, conversion tracking with funnel metrics, credit rewards, and tier progression.

screens.title: Web — Settings: Team & Roles
screens.purpose: Manage team members within a workspace: invite, assign roles, set permissions, and remove access. Supports Owner, Admin, Manager, Editor, Viewer, and custom roles.

screens.title: Web — Settings: Workspace
screens.purpose: Workspace general settings — name, logo, timezone, language, default currency, and connected platforms overview. Foundation configuration for the entire workspace that affects all modules and users.

screens.title: Web — A/B Testing Engine
screens.purpose: Generate N video variants (different hooks, CTAs, thumbnails, music) → publish all → report an eligible observational winner or inconclusive result using M10/API evidence thresholds after test duration.

screens.title: Web — AI Remix Studio
screens.purpose: 3-phase pipeline: (1) Input reference video + settings → (2) AI extracts Creative DNA (structure, pacing, style) → (3) Generate original remix with originality safeguards. Includes side-by-side comparison and per-scene editing.

screens.title: Web — Asset Library
screens.purpose: Central library for all AI-generated and uploaded media assets. Filterable gallery with metadata, usage tracking, and quick publish shortcuts.

screens.title: Web — Character Builder & Library
screens.purpose: Create and manage AI-generated video characters — consistent personas for product demos, tutorials, and UGC-style content. Characters maintain visual consistency across productions.

screens.title: Web — Clip Factory
screens.purpose: Upload a long video → AI detects and extracts best clips → rate by virality score → batch export. Designed for repurposing YouTube/podcast content into short-form TikTok/Reels clips.

screens.title: Web — Image-to-Video Mode
screens.purpose: Transform static images into animated videos. AI adds motion (pan, zoom, parallax, morphing), transitions between images, and optional music/voice-over. Ideal for converting product photos, carousel posts, or artwork into video content.

screens.title: Web — AI Studio Launcher
screens.purpose: The AI Studio Launcher is the gateway to all AI-powered content generation tools. It presents production modes as cards — each mode opens a specialized tool (Video, Image, Remix, Avatar, Voiceover, Music, Subtitle, Thumbnail, B-Roll, Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video). Also shows recent genera

screens.title: Web — Link-to-Video Mode
screens.purpose: Paste a URL (article, product page, blog post) → AI scrapes content → generates a video summary with visuals, voice-over, and text overlays. Great for repurposing written content into video.

screens.title: Web — Multi-Merge Mode
screens.purpose: Combine multiple media files (videos + images) into one polished video with AI transitions, voice-over, and music. Timeline-based editor with drag-to-reorder and transition controls.

screens.title: Web — Product Showcase Mode
screens.purpose: AI-generated product showcase videos from product images + description. Creates professional product demos, unboxing simulations, and feature highlights with AI voice-over and music.

screens.title: Web — Generation Queue
screens.purpose: The Generation Queue is the real-time monitoring hub for all AI generation jobs across every Studio mode. It shows active jobs with live progress, completed outputs ready for review, and failed jobs with retry options. This is the "task manager" of the AI Studio — creators return here to c

screens.title: Web — Quick Edit Mode
screens.purpose: Quick Edit Mode is a transcript-based video editor — the "text editor for video" concept.
